rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Good morning, Mrs. Chen. Tell me what has been going on.
rows.said: 早上好，陈太太。告诉我发生了什么事。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 我咳嗽发烧已经五天了。 How
rows.said: I've had a cough and fever for five days. How

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: How many days have you had this cough and fever?
rows.said: 您发烧和咳嗽几天了？

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 昨天量体温有38度5, So
rows.said: Yesterday, my temperature was 38.5 degrees, So

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Take one tablet twice a day for five days.
rows.said: 每天服用一片，连服五天。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 这个药一天要吃几次? Do not
rows.said: You need to take this medicine how many times a day?

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Do not skip any doses. Even if you start feeling better.
rows.said: 不要漏服。即使感觉好转了。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 我怕这药吃了会犯困,
rows.said: I'm afraid this medicine will make me drowsy,

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Come back in one week if the fever continues.
rows.said: 一周后如果发烧持续，请再来。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 谢谢医生。麻烦您了。
rows.said: Thank you, doctor. Sorry to bother you.
